description: Handwritten park/wake reports, and the wait exports each derives from at a host time (derivations: export index, host time, report index): a run whose answered question was resumed and whose second wait (an approval) is still parked with uncertain release, before and after the first wait's retention; a question that timed out unanswered; a redacted question; a budget wait woken by time; an approval its deadline ended after a decision came a millisecond before it; a question its run deadline ended unwoken. The report reads the retained waits only; content past retainUntil is expired and a redacted wait's content is redacted, each with its digest kept. A park entry names the wait's deadline; a deadline entry follows what woke the wait and comes before the unanswered end it caused.
